mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity and economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO exceeds its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 4.5%, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 4.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand and economic momentum, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS exceed their 3-month moving averages, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle economic expansions, a rising industrial production index (INDPRO) signals robust manufacturing activity and potential inflationary pressures, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed may tighten policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during late-cycle expansions when INDPRO is rising, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.5%, it indicates accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy and resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) reflects strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, which typically precedes positive equity market performance over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST is above its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the month-over-month change in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceeds 0.5%, it signals a strengthening labor market and rising consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS MoM growth > 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) indicates a monetary policy tightening cycle amid persistent inflation, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL are rising, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
